6. Momentum Stocks?
Strongest weekly gains among the leaders include CCI (1W: +12.69% | 1M: +33.28%) ABOVE TREND, TXN (1W: +11.96% | 1M: +11.73%) ABOVE TREND, and AMAT (1W: +12.27% | 1M: -17.54%) RECOVERY. Major 1W/1M divergence is present across multiple large stocks; treat RECOVERY moves as tactical, not confirmed trend reversals.

🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Mixed: sector returns were +1.17% 1W and -0.87% 1M; stock-level breadth counts were not provided. 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor balance over a concentrated style bet: sector breadth is strong, but top-stock leadership is narrow and the overall regime remains NEUTRAL. Monitor confirmed strength in JPM (1W: +2.09% | 1M: +4.37%) ABOVE TREND and LLY (1W: +5.13% | 1M: +18.72%) ABOVE TREND; be selective with RECOVERY names and reduce exposure to persistent laggards.

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Monitor follow-through in TXN (1W: +11.96% | 1M: +11.73%) ABOVE TREND and CCI (1W: +12.69% | 1M: +33.28%) ABOVE TREND; confirmation would support continuation. BEARISH: Watch whether GOOGL (1W: -12.46% | 1M: -17.51%) BELOW TREND and NOW (1W: -30.15% | 1M: -18.16%) BELOW TREND stabilize; continued weakness would reinforce downside pressure.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Real Estate (+3.10% 1W, +7.67% 1M), Materials (+2.36% 1W), and Industrials (+2.01% 1W) showed the strongest weekly sector returns; breadth within sectors was not supplied. BEARISH: Communication (-4.00% 1W, -3.60% 1M) remains weakest, while Consumer Staples fell 2.06% on the week.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Absolute price levels were not supplied. Watch for trend confirmation in TXN (1W: +11.96% | 1M: +11.73%) ABOVE TREND, continued recovery or renewed weakness in NVDA (1W: +0.68% | 1M: -6.45%) RECOVERY, and stabilization in GOOGL (1W: -12.46% | 1M: -17.51%) BELOW TREND.

📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
CAT (-45): price-target reduction; CAT (1W: -7.83% | 1M: -19.96%) is BELOW TREND, confirming weakness. GM (-45): privacy-settlement headline; GM (1W: +11.02% | 1M: +11.32%) is ABOVE TREND, diverging from negative sentiment.

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL; breadth is 9/11 sectors positive (Sector Strength), leadership is Narrow (4/5 Technology), and style is mixed with no clear leadership. TXN (1W: +11.96% | 1M: +11.73%) ABOVE TREND and LLY (1W: +5.13% | 1M: +18.72%) ABOVE TREND show relative strength. Major 1W/1M divergence warrants confirmation before treating rebounds as durable; positive PFE sentiment (+55) contrasts with its CORRECTION price pattern.
